image_description: Two Nile crocodiles resting on a grassy bank. The top crocodile has its mouth wide open in a basking posture, displaying teeth and the interior of the jaw. The bottom crocodile has its mouth closed. Both exhibit textured, armored skin with visible scutes. The background includes green grass and blurred earthy tones.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both subjects display the characteristic V-shaped snout distinct from the U-shaped alligator snout. The head shape is broad and triangular.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The checkpoint specifies 'when mouth is closed'. The bottom crocodile's mouth is closed, but the interlocking nature of the teeth (specifically the 4th lower tooth fitting into the upper notch) is not clearly visible due to the angle and resolution; only a few teeth protrude slightly. It does not 'clearly and fully' match the description of visible interlocking mechanics.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While eyes are dorsal, the resolution is insufficient to confirm 'vertical slit pupils' or the presence of a 'nictitating membrane'. These fine details are blurry or obscured.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Nostrils are clearly visible at the distal end of the snout on both subjects.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both bodies are elongated and covered in heavy armor/scutes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal surface shows clear, regular longitudinal rows of osteoderms.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Coloration is grey/brown, and texture appears rough and detailed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The interior of the open mouth and the visible under-jaw area of the top crocodile show pale, smoother scales consistent with ventral/inner jaw morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Limbs are largely occluded by the body and grass. Digit counting is impossible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tails extend out of the frame or are obscured; full length and compression cannot be verified.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The grass exhibits a repetitive, painterly texture with uniform blade shapes and lack of depth variation, typical of AI-generated backgrounds. Some blades appear to merge into the crocodile's skin without proper occlusion.
The connection between the lower jaw and the skull appears slightly soft and ill-defined. The anatomy of the jaw hinge is not mechanically clear, appearing somewhat fused with the neck scales.
The tip of the snout appears slightly warped or melted into the grass, lacking a sharp, solid edge.

Edge definition between crocodile and grass
